lines.text: Jupiter. No ground at all - we are on storm platforms above the cloud decks. The gravity here is 2.5 times Earth, so every jump feels heavy.
Lightning columns everywhere, and the saucers ride the storm. Do not fall - there is nothing below but ammonia.
The gravity is spiking with the storm. Every jump you make now lands heavier.
Shield Generator recovered! Radiation belts like these would fry the ship without it.
Generator stowed. The Great Red Spot is right there - a storm wider than Earth.
Lightning strikes in columns that flash first. Time your run between them.
Platform gaps need a running jump. The heavy gravity cuts your hang time.
Fire two bolts into each saucer, or bounce on top of them.
